highlight.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows Now in Technical Preview
highlight.summary: <cite index="11-1,11-2,11-3">GitHub Agentic Workflows let you automate repository tasks using AI agents that run within GitHub Actions. Write workflows in plain Markdown instead of complex YAML, and let AI handle intelligent decision-making for issue triage, pull request reviews, CI failure analysis, and repository maintenance.</cite> <cite index="15-8">GitHub Agentic Workflows deliver repository automation, running the coding agents you know and love, in GitHub Actions, with strong guardrails and security-first design principles.</cite>

resources.title: Claude Code: The Terminal-Native AI Coding Agent
resources.why_now: <cite index="5-2,5-3">Claude Code from Anthropic is the standout CLI tool of 2026. It runs in your terminal and can read, write, and refactor code across your project.</cite> <cite index="6-39,6-40,6-42">Anthropic's Claude Code plans, reads, edits, and runs commands across your codebase with permission prompts and tool use built in. It is the AI coding CLI that feels closest to having a senior engineer in your tmux pane. Reach for it when you want an agent that can actually finish a multi-file task, not just autocomplete a line.</cite>

resources.title: LocalStack 2026.04.0: Production-Ready AWS Emulation
resources.why_now: <cite index="24-3,24-13">LocalStack for AWS 2026.04.0 launches App Inspector, our new observability layer for local cloud development, alongside Athena and S3 Tables federation via Glue catalogs. This is the second monthly release on our calendar versioning cadence, and it ships the launch of App Inspector, our new observability layer for local cloud development.</cite> The shift to requiring auth tokens has consolidated the platform but improved developer experience with better tooling.

resources.title: Dagger + LocalStack: Composable CI/CD Pipelines
resources.why_now: <cite index="21-14,21-15">Dagger lets you write CI/CD pipelines as code in TypeScript, Go, or Python, running identically on your laptop and in CI. Replaces YAML configuration with type-safe, testable pipeline logic that works with any CI provider.</cite> <cite index="25-1,25-2,25-3">A Dagger module for running LocalStack (Community and Pro image) as a service within your Dagger pipelines. This module simplifies integrating LocalStack into your development and testing workflows.</cite>

resources.title: act: Debug GitHub Actions Locally
resources.why_now: <cite index="21-1,21-8">Learn how to use act to run GitHub Actions workflows locally, speed up CI development cycles, and debug failing pipelines without cloud commits.</cite> With GitHub Actions becoming more complex and <cite index="11-5,16-18">the gh aw CLI converts these into standard GitHub Actions workflows. That new architecture is rolled out, powering 71 million jobs per day</cite>, local testing becomes essential for rapid iteration.

claude_take: 2026 marks the convergence of AI agents and developer tooling - from Claude Code bringing autonomous coding to the terminal, to GitHub's Agentic Workflows making repository automation accessible through natural language. The shift toward local-first development tools like Dagger and LocalStack reflects developers' need for faster feedback loops and reduced cloud dependencies, while maintaining production parity.
